legal_name: Ambica Steels India Limited (name appears as a distinct entity in the navigation of the group website ambicasteels.com, listed separately from 'Ambica Steels Limited'; exact MCA-registered legal name NOT verified)
note: Registry data could not be verified: the search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned connection errors for the whole session, and registry aggregators (zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com) returned HTTP 403; Google returned HTTP 429. Only one primary source was readable: the group website https://www.ambicasteels.com, whose main navigation lists 'Ambica Steels India Limited' as a separate page alongside 'Ambica Steels Limited' (registered office shown for the group: C-54/1, Wazirpur Industrial Area, New Delhi 110052), and which describes the business as 'India's largest stainless steel long products manufacturer since 1970', ISO/EN 9100/IATF certified, exporting to 75+ countries. That supports role=manufacturer and a Delhi (Wazirpur, New Delhi) location, but it is a company self-description, not a registry record. The specific sub-pages (/ambica-steels-india-limited, /about-us, /corporate-governance) all returned HTTP 404, so no CIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, MCA status or audited revenue could be sourced. CIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, MCA status and FY25/FY26 revenue are therefore null - not public in any source I could reach, and not invented. No rejection basis established: no evidence of non-existence, strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy was found, so the entity is retained as unverified rather than rejected. Note also that 'Ambica Steels India Limited' and 'Ambica Steels Limited' appear to be two related but distinct legal entities in the same group - the exact entity behind the declared HS 7223 (stainless steel wire) trade must be confirmed against the invoice/PAN before use. Recommend re-verification of MCA master data and GSTIN once registry access is restored.
